label: 0.9.33 测试版
notes: 新增：一键匹配（点一个按钮自动找对手，不用交换房间号）
新增：匹配队列（先到先配、掉线自动移除、超时踢出）
新增：匹配界面（搜索中显示排队位置、可取消）
修复：服务器建房时持有锁再取锁导致死锁（第二个玩家匹配会卡死）
notes_en: New: one-click quick match (press one button, the server finds an opponent -- no room codes)
New: matchmaking queue (first come first served; disconnects are dropped; stale entries time out)
New: matchmaking screen (shows queue position, cancellable)
Fix: building a room while holding the server lock deadlocked (the second player's match would hang)
